nodes.description: Mapping of keccak256(contract name) to the trusted address of that system contract; the resolution root for every allow() modifier.
Address of the contract owner used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Current SKL price recalculated from network load and capacity.
Timestamp of the last price adjustment, compared against now plus COOLDOWN_TIME.
Cached number of online nodes refreshed by checkAllNodes/initNodes.
Locked (slashed) token amount per holder, mutated by handleSlash and forgive.
Counter of active nodes, decremented without SafeMath in _setNodeLeft/_setNodeLeaving.
Counter of leaving nodes, decremented without SafeMath in _setNodeLeft.
Per node free space bookkeeping used for schain placement.
Array of locker contract names iterated to aggregate locked amounts.
Array of all delegation records, indexed by delegationId.
validatorId => Validator struct including validatorAddress and minimumDelegationAmount.
monthsCount => stake multiplier used to compute effective delegation amounts.
Remaining bounty pool of the current stage, decremented by payouts.
schainIndex => Rotation struct describing an ongoing node rotation.
ContractManager instance used by allow/allowTwo/allowThree permission modifiers.
External, unguarded price adjustment that mixes load, capacity, timestamps and multiplications to rewrite price.
Public function that refreshes totalNodes from Nodes.getNumberOnlineNodes().
Initializer that seeds price with INITIAL_PRICE and lastUpdated with now.
Private view that loops over all schains accumulating node count times partOfNode.
Slashing entry point restricted to the SkaleDKG contract via allow().
Admin-only function that reduces the locked amount of a holder.
External function restricted to DelegationController that increases _locked[holder].
Owner-only registry write that binds a contract name to a code-bearing address.
Creates a delegation proposal; performs many external calls and cross-contract accounting.
Slashing implementation restricted to Punisher; reduces delegated values and appends a slashing event.
Removes a schain and performs swap-and-pop over owner index arrays and schainsAtSystem.
Registers a new node, validating ip/name/port and allocating space bookkeeping.
Permission-checked status change deriving authority from owner, node ownership or validator id.
Bounty payout computation restricted to SkaleManager, heavily dependent on timestamps and unchecked subtraction.
Registers a validator keyed by msg.sender with fee rate and minimum delegation amount.
Signature recovery helper that validates s/v ranges and calls ecrecover.
Sends ETH with a full-gas low-level call, forwarding control to the recipient.
Initializer that grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender and stores the ContractManager.
Rotates a node out of a schain, selects a replacement and updates rotation state.
Owner-only removal of a locker from the _lockers array via swap-and-pop.
Owner-only addition of a locker name to the _lockers array.
Private status transition to Left that decrements node counters without SafeMath.
Virtual view returning the current month derived from block.timestamp.
Verifies a DKG complaint using G2 point arithmetic and bn256 precompiles.
Caller-controlled address used for access control, ownership and identity throughout the system.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for price updates, bounties, rotations and month accounting.
recipient.call{value: amount}("") forwards all remaining gas, enabling reentrancy on the recipient.
numberOfActiveNodes-- and numberOfLeavingNodes-- are unchecked and can underflow to 2**256-1.
Raw ecrecover usage whose result must be validated against address(0) and malleability.
Price updates are gated and scaled by now, allowing miner timestamp manipulation.
initialize can be front-run to claim DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE before the legitimate deployer.
Chained mul of ADJUSTMENT_SPEED, loadDiff, price and timeSkipped risks uint256 overflow.
staticcall to precompiled contracts 5/7/8 whose success flag is required.
Human readable contract name supplied to setContractsAddress.
Address registered as the trusted implementation for a contract name.
Validator identifier to be slashed.
Amount forwarded to DelegationController.confiscate.
Total network load computed inside adjustPrice.
Total network capacity computed inside adjustPrice.
Index of the node claiming a bounty.
Reported downtime used to penalise the bounty.
Reported latency used to scale down the bounty.
65 byte signature split into r, s and v.
Signed message hash passed to ecrecover.
Payable address receiving the ETH transfer.
Wei amount forwarded to the recipient.
Owner address of the created node.
NodeCreationParams struct with name, ip, public ip, port, public key and nonce.
Holder whose locked amount is forgiven.
Amount forgiven from the holder's locked balance.
Schain identifier to remove from the system.
Address of the ContractManager used for permission resolution.

edges.reason: contractsName is hashed and used as the registry key by setContractsAddress.
newContractsAddress is written into the trusted contract registry.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender before the registry write.
setContractsAddress stores the resolved address into the contracts mapping.
contractManagerAddress is stored as the trusted ContractManager.
initialize assigns contractManager used by every allow modifier.
msg.sender is granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE via _setupRole.
initialize can be front-run because the initializer guard does not restrict the caller.
allow modifier resolves the caller from the ContractManager registry.
msg.sender is compared with contractManager.contracts('DelegationController').
slash is gated by msg.sender matching the SkaleDKG registry address.
confiscate is restricted to the Punisher address resolved from the registry.
slash calls confiscate on the DelegationController.
confiscate reduces delegation values recorded in delegations.
delegate triggers an external call chain into Punisher.handleSlash which mutates _locked.
handleSlash increases _locked[holder] before all accounting settles.
forgive subtracts the forgiven amount from _locked.
holder selects the _locked entry to forgive.
amount bounds the forgiven value.
validatorId selects the validator to slash.
amount is forwarded to DelegationController.confiscate.
forgive is guarded by onlyAdmin which reads msg.sender.
sendValue performs a low-level call forwarding all gas to recipient.
the recipient contract can reenter sendValue before effects are settled.
recipient is the low-level call target.
amount is the value forwarded in the call.
adjustPrice rewrites price using a chain of mul/sub operations.
adjustPrice stores block.timestamp into lastUpdated.
price * loadDiff * timeSkipped chained multiplication may overflow uint256.
price movement is driven by the miner-controllable block.timestamp.
now is compared with lastUpdated to gate the price update.
local load feeds the price adjustment formula.
local capacity is the divisor of the price adjustment.
_getTotalLoad supplies the load value consumed by adjustPrice.
checkAllNodes refreshes the cached totalNodes counter.
Pricing.initialize seeds price with INITIAL_PRICE.
Pricing.initialize sets lastUpdated to the current timestamp.
_setNodeLeft executes unchecked decrements of the node counters.
numberOfActiveNodes-- can underflow if status bookkeeping is inconsistent.
numberOfLeavingNodes-- can underflow when the node was not in Leaving state.
Bounty.getBounty reward computation depends on now.
getBounty subtracts the payout from _stagePool with unchecked sub.
nodeIndex selects the node being rewarded.
downtime parameter feeds the bounty reduction.
latency parameter feeds the bounty reduction.
signature bytes are parsed into r, s and v.
hash parameter is passed directly to ecrecover.
recover relies on ecrecover and must reject address(0) results.
registerValidator binds msg.sender as the validator address.
registerValidator writes the new Validator struct.
setNodeInMaintenance derives permission from msg.sender ownership or validator id.
delegate uses msg.sender as the delegation holder.
from selects the owner recorded for the new node.
params carry the node data validated by createNode.
createNode allocates space bookkeeping in spaceOfNodes.
removeLocker mutates the _lockers array with swap-and-pop.
addLocker pushes a locker name into _lockers.
removeLocker is guarded by onlyOwner.
addLocker is guarded by onlyOwner.
rotateNode is gated by allowTwo over msg.sender.
rotateNode updates the rotations mapping.
rotation freeze windows are computed from now.
verify delegates curve math to the bn256 precompiles via staticcall.
schainId selects the schain to remove.
getCurrentMonth derives the month from the miner-controlled block.timestamp.
delegation month accounting consumes the current month.
createNode records block.timestamp as lastRewardDate.

normalization_plan.reason: contractsName is a parameter only meaningful inside ContractManager.setContractsAddress.
newContractsAddress is a parameter consumed only by setContractsAddress.
load is a local variable computed inside Pricing.adjustPrice.
capacity is a local variable consumed by Pricing.adjustPrice.
signature parameter is parsed by ECDSA.recover.
hash parameter is consumed by ECDSA.recover.
recipient parameter is the call target in Address.sendValue.
amount parameter is the transferred value in Address.sendValue.
from parameter is bound during Nodes.createNode.
params struct is validated and stored by Nodes.createNode.
holder parameter selects the entry modified by Punisher.forgive.
amount parameter is applied by Punisher.forgive.
schainId parameter is consumed by SchainsInternal.removeSchain.
contractManagerAddress parameter is stored by Permissions.initialize.
